title: Builder BLD-004: Copy canon

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-004.

detail:
B0 Align, pass BLD-004 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-004). Copy canon. Scope: guidelines + repo strings. Build: Primary action on Commons: --pa for the one primary, ink for secondary, no violet. Update site-themes.md. Calendar name: apply the owner's pick everywhere, including the Circle tab. Scope banned words to Frequency's own copy; exempt owner and theme names. Record the Vera authority decision (drafts as diffs, or coaching only). Done when: Text pin: the chosen calendar name appears, the other does not; Voice lint passes with owner names exempt. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), Design system adherence check, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: nothing. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

2026-11-04 (ADR-1939): the calendar is "What's Happening" wherever a person reads its name (the Space tab, the Space function, the Space calendar page title, the Circle tab and its title), all from one constant, lib/calendar/name.ts; routes, the .ics feed and code keys keep calendar. lintVoice takes exempt names (owner and theme names are names, not phrases) and author: 'owner', which softens a banned-word finding into a suggestion; Frequency's own copy stays held to the list. ADR-1939 records the primary action on Commons (--pa for the one primary, ink for secondary, no violet; supersedes the handoff's site-themes.md row, which is read-only) and Vera's authority (questions only, no drafts as diffs; BLD-402 builds to it).
